skill.name: ecommerce-detail-copywriter
skill.description: Draft product detail pages and purchase FAQs from supplied product facts. Optional SocialDataX lookups support Douyin and Xiaohongshu.
skill.summary: Turn verified product details into listing copy and buyer FAQs.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown formatting, readable Chinese prose, or references that do not run commands or access secrets. The online CLI executes a mutable npm package with access to credentials, and its examples lack safe argument handling guidance. No evidence found of an embedded payload, audit-directed prompt injection, or credential theft in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Online CLI commands execute a mutable npm release.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and verify its integrity before execution. Require user approval before downloading or running it.

remediation.issue: The CLI can use stored credentials and credentials inherited from its environment.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an approved connector or credential store. Give the CLI only a scoped service credential and do not expose unrelated environment secrets.

remediation.issue: Shell command examples contain placeholders for user inputs.
remediation.suggestion: Pass values as separate process arguments without a shell. Validate platform URLs and identifier formats before making a request.

remediation.issue: A supported link can trigger a lookup without clear approval for service charges.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the lookup destination and possible credit use first. Offer to draft from supplied facts instead.

content.user_title: Write Product Detail Pages and Buyer FAQs
content.value_statement: Raw product specifications can leave shoppers unsure what to buy. Turn verified facts into structured product pages and buyer FAQs without adding unsupported claims.
actual_capabilities: Draft a page from supplied facts without a product lookup.
Organize copy into a headline, selling points, use cases, specifications, and purchase FAQs.
Adapt wording to a specified audience, platform, and tone.
Document fact sources, flag conflicting details, and list missing information.
Look up supported Douyin and Xiaohongshu products through a configured SocialDataX connection.
Use a small set of comparable listings for structural reference when requested.
limitations: Automated product lookups cover only Douyin and Xiaohongshu.
Online lookups require SocialDataX authentication and may use service credits.
Supplied and retrieved claims are not independently verified.
The skill drafts copy but does not publish listings or edit seller accounts.

use_cases.title: Draft a First Product Listing
use_cases.description: Turn a product fact sheet into a detail page, with missing specifications listed separately.

use_cases.title: Rewrite Copy for a New Audience
use_cases.description: Adapt an existing listing for a new audience while preserving verified specifications and offer conditions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Buyer FAQs
use_cases.description: Draft consistent answers about product use and purchasing from approved specifications and policies.

prompt_templates.title: Start with Product Facts
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a short fact sheet.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a product page and buyer FAQ from these facts: [facts]. Use only what I provide. List missing details after the draft.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Listing
prompt_templates.scenario: You have existing copy and a specific audience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite [listing] for [audience] on [platform] in a [tone] tone. Keep the verified specifications and offer conditions from [facts]. Draft a headline, selling points, and buyer FAQ.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Conflicting Product Details
prompt_templates.scenario: You have two sources that disagree.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a page from [fact sheet] and [existing listing] without online lookup. Exclude conflicting claims from the draft. After the FAQ, list each conflict and its sources for review.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Listing Structures
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a product brief and selected reference excerpts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a page for [target product] using [verified facts]. Review up to three [reference excerpts] for layout ideas only. Do not copy wording or transfer competitor claims. Finish with source notes and a list of details to verify.

output_examples.input: Write a short draft for a 500 mL stainless steel bottle with a screw cap. The audience is commuters.
output: Headline: A 500 mL stainless steel bottle for your commute.
Specifications: 500 mL capacity, stainless steel body, screw cap.
Buyer FAQ: What is the capacity? It holds 500 mL.
Source: Supplied product facts. Confirm before adding insulation or care claims.

output_examples.input: Draft a listing for a tote with one interior pocket. The fact sheet says 38 cm wide, but the current listing says 40 cm.
output: Headline: A tote with an interior pocket.
Selling point: Keep small items separate in the interior pocket.
Buyer FAQ: Does the tote have an interior pocket? Yes, it has one.
Verify width before publication: The fact sheet states 38 cm. The current listing states 40 cm.

best_practices: Provide verified specifications, the intended audience, and any offer conditions.
Review prices, promotions, and purchase policies before publishing.
Use supplied facts when possible and approve any external lookup before sharing product information.
anti_patterns: Treating competitor specifications or claims as facts about your product.
Guessing missing certifications, performance figures, or return policies.
Pasting API keys into prompts or product drafts.

faq.question: Can I use this skill without an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide enough product facts to draft the page without an online lookup.

faq.question: Which product links can it look up?
faq.answer: The documented online lookup supports Douyin and Xiaohongshu product links or IDs. For other platforms, provide the details directly.

faq.question: What does an online lookup require?
faq.answer: It requires a configured SocialDataX CLI or authenticated MCP connection. Lookups may use service credits.

faq.question: Can it use competing listings as references?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask it to reference a few related listings for structure and presentation. It should not copy their text or claim their features.

faq.question: What happens when specifications are missing or conflict?
faq.answer: The draft uses supported facts and lists gaps or conflicts separately for review.

faq.question: Will it publish or update my listings?
faq.answer: No. It prepares copy for review and does not change your listings or seller account.
